description: OuchiColon everyday Japanese conversation dictionary. Contains no stored child utterance history.

integration.match: normalize text, then exact match against each entry's patterns, including common speech variants
integration.response_selection: choose one of five; avoid immediate repetition
integration.conversation_state: keep current_topic only in memory for the current conversation; do not persist utterance text
integration.routing: use session_action, topic_value, and next_topic to continue, correct, wait for a topic, stop, repeat, or end naturally
integration.safety: existing safety/privacy engine must run before general dictionary matching
integration.question_policy: questions are optional and sparse; ask at most one follow-up in a response; never ask after a stop or goodbye
